# cycle_tls_certificates (Data Source)

Lists user-supplied TLS certificates in the hub. Private material (`bundle`, `private_key`) is never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List user-supplied TLS certificates. Private material is never returned.
data "cycle_tls_certificates" "all" {}

output "certificate_ids" {
  value = [for c in data.cycle_tls_certificates.all.certificates : c.id]
}

output "live_domains" {
  value = flatten([
    for c in data.cycle_tls_certificates.all.certificates : c.domains
    if c.state == "live"
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `certificates` (Attributes List) User-supplied TLS certificates in the hub. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--certificates))

<a id="nestedatt--certificates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `certificates`

Read-Only:

- `domains` (List of String) Domains associated with the certificate.
- `expires` (String) Expiration timestamp of the certificate, as RFC3339.
- `hub_id` (String) The ID of the hub this certificate belongs to.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of the TLS certificate.
- `state` (String) The current state of the certificate.
- `user_supplied` (Boolean) Whether this certificate was uploaded instead of generated by the platform.
